channel.title: LLM Systems Architecture
channel.description: Notes for engineers on LLM inference architecture and systems engineering: vLLM serving, MLA attention, InfiniBand fabrics, and production Agent runtimes.

item.title: DeepSeek Inference Stack: DeepInfer and deepseek-recipe
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: DeepSeek's production inference stack: DeepInfer kernels, prefill-decode split, DSpark speculative decoding, SWA replay, and the deepseek-recipe protocol layer.

item.title: InfiniBand Production Tuning: OpenSM and NCCL
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Production InfiniBand setup: install OFED, run OpenSM with a standby, audit the fabric with ibdiagnet, and tune NCCL for GPUDirect RDMA. It finds bad links.

item.title: InfiniBand Fabrics: Fat-Tree, Rail-Optimized, SHARP
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How large GPU clusters cable InfiniBand as a fat-tree with rail-optimized planes, and how adaptive routing plus SHARP improve collective communication.

item.title: InfiniBand Architecture: Rates, Credits, and OpenSM
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: InfiniBand link rates from HDR through XDR, how credit-based flow control avoids drops, and how OpenSM discovers the fabric and installs forwarding tables.

item.title: Linux Kernel Networking: NAPI, Rings, and XDP
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How a NIC ring, DMA, and NAPI polling receive packets, how sk_buff carries them in the kernel, and where eBPF XDP drops or forwards before the stack, plus RSS.

item.title: RDMA Basics: Kernel Bypass, Queue Pairs, RoCEv2
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How RDMA registers memory, bypasses the kernel, and copies nothing in software; how queue pairs transfer data; and how RoCEv2 uses PFC and ECN plus memory keys.

item.title: Datacenter Networks: Clos, Leaf-Spine, and EVPN
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why datacenter networks replace a three-tier STP tree with Clos leaf-spine, and how a BGP underlay plus EVPN-VXLAN stretches Layer 2 across racks. See ECMP.

item.title: DNS, Sockets, and UDP versus TCP
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How DNS resolves a name from root to authority, how a socket 5-tuple lets one port serve many flows, and where UDP and TCP choose different guarantees.

item.title: Enterprise LAN: VLAN, DHCP, and NAT
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How 802.1Q VLANs split one switch into separate broadcast domains, how DHCP DORA leases addresses, and how NAPT forwards ports through a gateway. See relay.

item.title: TCP Congestion Control: Reno, Cubic, BBR, QUIC
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare loss-based Reno and Cubic with model-based BBR, then how HTTP/3 carries the same application traffic on QUIC instead of a TCP connection. See pacing.

item.title: IP Addressing: Subnet Masks, CIDR, and Gateways
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How subnet masks and CIDR split an IPv4 address into network and host with bitwise AND, and what a default gateway does when traffic leaves the subnet.

item.title: IP Routing and the TCP State Machine
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How IP picks a next hop with longest-prefix match, how TCP walks its handshake and teardown states, and how the sliding window caps unacknowledged data.

item.title: Networking Basics: Media, Collision Domains, and MAC
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How computer networks start: bits on copper and fiber, hub collision domains, how switches learn MAC addresses, and how ARP resolves an IP to hardware.

item.title: Container Networking: veth, Bridge, and iptables
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How a container packet leaves its network namespace on a veth pair, is switched by MAC on a Linux bridge, and reaches the outside through iptables NAT.

item.title: Docker Internals: Namespaces, cgroups, and OverlayFS
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: A container is a restricted Linux process, not a small virtual machine: namespaces limit its view, cgroups v2 limit resources, and OverlayFS stores layers.

item.title: Docker Swarm: Raft Consensus and Routing Mesh
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How Docker SwarmKit splits managers and workers, keeps cluster state consistent with Raft, and publishes services through an IPVS routing mesh. VXLAN included.

item.title: Kubernetes App Networking: gRPC and Drains
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why long-lived gRPC connections stick to one Kubernetes backend, and how a service mesh drains those connections so a rollout does not drop in-flight traffic.

item.title: Kubernetes Control Plane and Reconciliation
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How Kubernetes stores desired state through a declarative API and etcd, how the scheduler places pods, and how controllers reconcile toward that state.

item.title: Kubernetes Control Plane: Aggregated API and etcd
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How WatchCache, an aggregated API server, and APF extend the Kubernetes control plane, and which etcd settings matter once the cluster grows to 10k nodes.

item.title: Databases on Kubernetes: Local NVMe and Fencing
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How to place a database on Kubernetes local NVMe, tune RocksDB and WAL flushes, and fence an old primary so it cannot keep writing after a failover event.

item.title: Kubernetes GPU Scheduling with the GPU Operator
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How the GPU Operator installs drivers and the device plugin, how MIG slices a GPU, and how topology-aware scheduling scales vLLM and SGLang inference services.

item.title: Kubernetes Networking: CNI, Cilium, Gateway API
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare the Flannel, Calico BGP, and Cilium eBPF datapaths, and how the Gateway API lets separate roles manage Kubernetes traffic policy. Replaces iptables.

item.title: Kubernetes Operators: CRDs and KubeBuilder
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How an operator encodes manual operations as a controller, how a CRD registers a new resource, and how KubeBuilder reconcile loops and finalizers clean it up.

item.title: Kubernetes Runtimes: NRI, Kata, gVisor, cgroups
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why PLEG slows a Kubernetes node, how an NRI plugin changes container setup, and what Kata, gVisor, and cgroups v2 each isolate or limit. Sandboxes differ.

item.title: Kubernetes Scheduling: Plugins and Gang Scheduling
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How the Scheduling Framework loads custom plugins, and how gang scheduling plus the descheduler place a batch job and move pods when the cluster shifts.

item.title: Kubernetes Storage: CSI, PV/PVC, and StatefulSet
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How the CSI provisions a PV and binds a PVC on demand, and how a StatefulSet gives each pod a stable network name and its own persistent volume. It persists.

item.title: Continuous Batching and Chunked Prefill
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why one long prefill still blocks other decode steps after continuous batching, and how chunked prefill splits that work so waiting requests can run too.

item.title: Attention Kernels: FlashAttention and FlashInfer
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How FlashAttention computes attention in SRAM tiles instead of materializing the score matrix, and how FlashInfer reads paged KV cache during decode steps.

item.title: Inference Engines: vLLM, SGLang, TRT-LLM, llama.cpp
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare the scheduler loop and execution backend in vLLM v1, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and llama.cpp when choosing an engine for throughput or a latency target.

item.title: Roofline Model: Why Prefill and Decode Differ
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Use the roofline model to see why prefill is compute-bound while decode is memory-bound, and how that splits time-to-first-token from per-token latency.

item.title: MHA, GQA, and MLA: Attention and KV Memory
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare KV-cache size for MHA, GQA, and DeepSeek MLA, and how matrix absorption during decode stores fewer multi-head tensors and cuts memory traffic.

item.title: MoE Inference Internals: Expert Parallelism (EP), Dynamic Routing Gating, and All-to-All Overlapping
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: MoE inference internals: DeepSeek-V3 gating, Expert Parallelism (EP) All-to-All communication, CUTLASS Grouped GEMM kernels, and DualPipe overlap schedules.

item.title: PagedAttention: Paged KV Cache without Fragmentation
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How vLLM PagedAttention splits the KV cache into logical blocks on physical GPU memory, reduces fragmentation, and shares a prefix with copy-on-write.

item.title: Prefill-Decode Split and Distributed KV Transfer
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why prefill and decode belong on separate pools, how RDMA moves KV cache between those nodes, and how a cluster schedules the pooled cache across the cluster.

item.title: Prefix Caching: Hash Blocks and RadixAttention
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How prefix caching reuses computed KV blocks by hash, and how SGLang RadixAttention matches those blocks on a radix tree and evicts leaves with an LRU policy.

item.title: Reasoning Inference: Test-Time Compute and KV Scheduling
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How long reasoning traces increase KV-cache pressure, and what test-time compute, speculative trees, and tiered KV storage change in the serving path.

item.title: AI Agent Memory Architecture: From Working Memory to Episodic Memory & Hierarchical Graph RAG
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Design agent working, episodic, and long-term memory with sourced retrieval concepts, a clearly scoped Python prototype, provenance, ACLs, conflict handling, and deletion.

item.title: Agentic Loops & State Machine Design: From ReAct to Deterministic Control Flows
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why prompt chaining and unconstrained ReAct loops fail in production AI systems. A deep architectural dissection of agent failure modes, Finite State Machine (FSM) graph flows, tool-calling resilience, and circuit breakers with runnable code.

item.title: Browser-use Architecture: DOM Distillation and Vision
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How Browser-use distills a page's DOM, grounds clickable elements with vision marks, and runs those actions inside a stateful agent loop that can retry.

item.title: SGLang vs vLLM: Prefix Caching, Structured Outputs, and Reproducible Evaluation
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare SGLang RadixAttention and vLLM APC, structured-output backends, minimal serving baselines, and reproducible cold/warm-cache latency and throughput evaluation.

item.title: Speculative Decoding from Draft Models to EAGLE-3
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Why speculative decoding can speed generation without changing the sampling distribution, and how to enable draft models through EAGLE-3 in vLLM and SGLang.

item.title: GRPO and Test-Time Compute without a Critic
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: What test-time compute moves into the generation step, and how GRPO removes PPO's critic and updates the policy from advantages inside a sampled group.

item.title: DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi K3: 32-GPU Topology and Debugging
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Deploy DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi K3 on a 4-node 32-GPU topology, budget memory per GPU, and debug NUMA, MoE skew, CUDA Graph false OOM, and PFC deadlock. See Ray.

item.title: Kimi K3 vs GLM-5.3 vs DeepSeek-V4: Architecture, Benchmarks and Deployment
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro with sourced architecture facts, matching benchmark versions, checkpoint formats, and workload evaluation plans.

item.title: Agent Environment Scaling: Tasks, Reset, and Checks
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: What agent environment scaling needs: varied tasks, a resettable state, independent checks, a careful reading of terminal scores, and cleanup after a timeout.

item.title: Kimi KDA, DeepSeek MLA and V4 CSA/HCA: Long-Context Cache and GPU Memory
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Understand KDA recurrent state, MLA latent caches, and DeepSeek-V4 CSA/HCA sequence compression, with explicit memory formulas and reproducible measurement rules.

item.title: Agent Reflection and Self-Correction with MCTS
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How an agent checks itself with an actor-critic pair, then searches candidate fixes with Monte Carlo tree search, using test-time compute for self-correction.

item.title: Agent Orchestration and Evals for Compounding Error
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How a small per-step error compounds across an agent workflow, and how splitting work with orchestration plus repeatable evals keeps that drift visible.

item.title: Deep Dive into AI Agent Architecture Evolution: From Prompt to Loop Engineering
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: A deep dive into the evolution of AI Agent architectures, exploring the 4-layer control plane extrapolation from Prompt, Context, Harness to Loop Engineering, and the 4 diseases of the ReAct architecture.

item.title: Advanced Tool Use in Agent Architecture: Dynamic Discovery, Sandboxing, and Self-Healing Recovery
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Implement dynamic tool retrieval, MCP initialization and pagination, gVisor container execution, cleanup after timeouts, and bounded recovery with Python examples.

item.title: Building a Lightweight Agent Framework from Scratch: State Machines and Event Streams
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Build a Python agent state machine with SQLite approval checkpoints, restart recovery, single-use approvals, rejection handling, step budgets, and async events.

item.title: Communication Protocols and Concurrency Control in Multi-Agent Systems
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Build asyncio agent mailboxes and a message bus with isolated payload copies, bounded delivery, graceful shutdown, CAS document updates, and token-bucket limiting.

item.title: Agent Observability & Debugging: The Path from Black Box to White Box
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: AI Agents are not traditional software; we are debugging the reasoning process rather than the code itself. This article explores Trajectory Evaluation, LLM-as-a-Judge, and practical applications of mainstream Agent observability tools like LangSmith and Langfuse.

item.title: Context Engineering Guide: Managing Context Window like RAM
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: The hottest concept in 2026, evolving from Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering. A deep dive into managing the context window through Write, Select, Compress, and Isolate strategies to solve long-context amnesia, hallucinations, and context poisoning.

item.title: AI Coding Mastery: From 'Build Me an X' to Architecture Orchestrator
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Tools don't matter — methodology does. A deep dive into six core methods for mastering AI coding: Spec-Driven Development, Context Engineering, TDD Verification Loops, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Advanced Prompting, and Session Hygiene. Plus a 20+ tool matrix and five anti-patterns to avoid.

item.title: Reject Benchmark Hacking: How to Build an LLM Evaluation System for Your Business (LLM-as-a-Judge)
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Cease the obsession with writing more code; shift focus to deep evaluation thinking. We deconstruct LLM-as-a-Judge biases, the mathematics behind metrics, and reshaping CI/CD defenses for probabilistic systems.

item.title: LLM Quantization Hands-On Guide: Four Routes from Zero to Production
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Hands-on LLM quantization guide: download and run GGUF models (Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, llama.cpp, Ollama), quantize with AWQ/GPTQ, and deploy vLLM FP8 in production with copy-paste code.

item.title: The Critical Crossroads in AI History: Why Was *That One* Chosen Every Time?
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: A retrospective of six pivotal technology crossroads in AI's seventy-year history, dissecting the compute constraints, data dividends, and scalability logic behind each historical choice.

item.title: vLLM Online Inference: Architecture, Tuning, and Billing
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How to serve online with vLLM: PagedAttention, continuous batching, prefix caching, an OpenAI-compatible API, tuning, token billing, and Docker monitoring.

item.title: NVIDIA GPU Driver Stack: Kernel Modules to Containers
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How the Linux NVIDIA stack fits together, from nvidia-dkms and userspace libraries to nvidia-utils and the metapackage, on desktops, containers, and DGX hosts.

item.title: LLM Quantization: FP32 to FP8, INT4, and NF4
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: How FP8, INT8, INT4, and NF4 apply to weights, activations, or the KV cache, and which measurements separate memory use, speed, and output quality in practice.

item.title: 7 Runtime Practices for Building AI Agents
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Based on a real data analysis agent project, this article distills 7 reusable Agent Runtime practices covering state exposure, tool design, context control, guardrails, delegation, and trace-driven iteration.

item.title: MCP Deep Dive: The USB-C Port for AI
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: From architecture to hands-on development, a complete guide to the Model Context Protocol. Includes Python SDK tutorial, security mechanisms, and ecosystem comparison.

item.title: Skills Deep Dive: Give Your AI Coding Assistant a Professional Brain
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: From core principles to cross-platform practice, a complete guide to the AI coding assistant Skills system. Covers SKILL.md mechanics, six-platform comparison, hands-on writing guide, and best practices.

item.title: Prompt Engineering Practice Guide
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: An in-depth exploration of designing effective prompts to improve model output quality. Covers core techniques like Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct with practical examples.

item.title: Deep Dive into 11 AI Foundation Model Trends in 2026
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: From Thinking reasoning modes to Agentic applications, a deep dive into the top 11 trends in AI foundation models for 2026.

item.title: Building AI Agent Applications from Scratch
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: A step-by-step guide to building intelligent agent systems using LangChain and the Claude API. Includes complete code and architecture design.

item.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in Practice: Strategies & Production Best Practices
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: A complete guide on how to use retrieval-augmented generation strategies and production best practices. Covers vector databases, semantic chunking, ColBERT reranking, GraphRAG, and automated Ragas evaluation.

item.title: 2026 Model Comparison: GPT-5.4, Claude 4.6, Gemini
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Compare GPT-5.4, Claude 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro by API capability, token price, and calling pattern, with checks you can rerun and a self-hosted cost formula.

item.title: Multimodal AI Models Starter Guide
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Explore the vision and text capabilities of multimodal models like GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, with practical use cases in image and video analysis.

item.title: LLM Fine-Tuning Guide: How It Works, Real-World Use Cases, and Workflows
item.dc:creator: ifnodoraemon
item.description: Discover how LLM fine-tuning works under the hood, explore proven enterprise use cases (LoRA, QLoRA, Full Fine-Tuning), and learn end-to-end workflows from data preparation to vLLM serving.
